tutorial.title: Trabalhando com APIs
tutorial.descriptionContent: Resolva exercícios independentes de Python que criam solicitações de API e processam suas respostas.
tutorial.shortDescriptionContent: Aprendizes de Python que concluíram os tutoriais de API fornecidos

executableContent.instructions: Complete `filter_courses()` para que ela envie uma solicitação `GET` para a URL fornecida com o dicionário `filters` como parâmetros da solicitação e retorne a lista `\"results\"` da resposta JSON analisada.

files.name: script.py
files.solvedContent:
import requests

def filter_courses():
  url = "https://things.mimo.dev/api/things"
  filters = {"category": "electronics"}
  response = requests.get(url, params=filters)
  data = response.json()
  return data["results"]

import requests

def load_airport(airport_id):
  base_url = "https://airports.mimo.dev"
  path = f"/airports/{airport_id}"
  url = f"{base_url}{path}"
  response = requests.get(url)
  data = response.json()
  return data["name"]

files.solvedContent:
import requests

def find_character(name):
  url = "https://swapi.mimo.dev/api/people"
  filters = {"search": name}
  response = requests.get(url, params=filters)
  response.raise_for_status()
  data = response.json()
  return data["results"][0]["name"]

import requests

def load_pokemon(pokemon_id):
  url = f"https://pokedex.mimo.dev/api/pokemon/{pokemon_id}"
  response = requests.get(url)
  response.raise_for_status()
  data = response.json()
  return data["name"]
